name: order_lipid_panel
description: Orders a fasting lipid panel including total cholesterol, LDL, HDL, and triglycerides. Used for cardiovascular risk assessment and monitoring lipid-lowering therapy.

fasting_status.description: Whether patient has fasted for 9-12 hours

clinical_indication.description: Clinical reason for ordering lipid panel

when_to_use: Family history of hyperlipidemia or premature cardiovascular disease
